stem: A test loses overall. The team then slices the results into 30 country and device segments and finds 2 segments with wins at p < 0.05. What should they do?

options.text: Ship the change to those 2 segments, since each of the wins is significant
Treat the segment wins as hypotheses and test them again in a new experiment
Report the overall loss as wrong, since 2 of the segments show a win
Add the 2 segments' lifts together to get the true overall effect
